source_validation.git_blob_validation_method: One read-only git cat-file --batch lookup at the recorded full revision; SHA-256 and byte length compared for every tracked input.

measured_process_rss.scope: Whole instrumented process during measured interactions; sampled peaks may miss shorter spikes. This gate cannot establish component allocation cost or absence of leaks.

interpretation: These are explicit engineering defaults, not official Flutter thresholds or a user-approved product budget.
Frame percentiles use nearest rank and the complete independent FrameTiming arrays, not bounded VM timeline retention.
Build and raster stages are assessed separately because rendering is pipelined; totalSpan includes scheduling and is not a count of displayed dropped frames.
The fixed measured-process RSS limits are a desktop harness risk gate; component memory and leak assessment remain unassessed even when it passes.
One passing observed run does not establish repeat-run stability or acceptance on other devices, platforms, accessibility configurations or physical input.

unconnected_profile_process.description: After the failed preparation, a system open command started an app without a connected driver. The operator verified its absolute app path and sole owned process, then sent SIGTERM before starting the foreground capture. No measured evidence is attributed to it.

operator_reported_preparation_sequence.valid_foreground_run: The initial driver foreground attempt returned open exit 1. Before WAITING, the operator used system open -a successfully, then Window menu makeKeyAndOrderFront; actual resumed state, explicit Start and READY were observed before measurement.
operator_reported_preparation_sequence.scope: Operator report of setup actions; no LaunchServices cause is established.

embedded_original_observation.scope: Post-capture process observation; process start times overlap the recorded P3 run, CPU usage here is not a measurement from that run. No playback content was read or controlled.

external_process_observation.interpretation: Both reported process starts fall inside Records sampling, after Prompt and Diff. Every Records-and-later workload failed, while Diff had already failed its 5/495 over-interval gate before these starts. This is a temporal association, not proof of CPU/GPU causality or grounds for discarding valid failures. ps CPU percentages were read after capture and are not capture-time measurements.
external_process_observation.operator_control: The operator asked the user to pause video temporarily for a prospective same-source comparison. No agent controlled IINA or inspected playback content; no comparison result is claimed.

measurement_conditions.agent_cli_during_sampling: All other CI/diagnostic agents were paused; activation CUA actions preceded READY, and assessment commands followed completion, per operator report.
measurement_conditions.other_user_applications: Left open; there was no claim of whole-machine isolation.
measurement_conditions.native_environment: All15 monitor records are verified_stable with no changes.
measurement_conditions.rss_scope: Whole instrumented process. Sampled peaks may miss shorter spikes; lifetime max includes outside-window work.
measurement_conditions.trace_scope: Driver decoding completed without failures. Lossless transport does not recover VM events evicted before retrieval; this summary makes no full VM-history claim.

historical_evidence.preservation: Historical valid failures and failed preparations remain unchanged; no best-of-runs aggregation is made.
